title: slotted-burst-quotas-and-sla-smoothing-for-dedicated-fleets
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: customers observed fast repeated short bursts from tenants that depleted reservation budgets too quickly and produced noisy utilization spikes which confused autoscalers and billing. This PR introduces a slotted burst quota scheme and an SLA smoothing window to make dedicated fleet burst behavior predictable and billable without sacrificing tail latency. Goals: 1) bound instantaneous burst allocation with fixed-size time slots per tenant, 2) amortize burst consumption across a configurable smoothing window to avoid autoscaler thrash, 3) emit new telemetry for billing and SLO tracking, 4) remain backward-compatible with existing reservation/percentile contracts. Approach: add a slot allocator that carves each tenant's burst budget into M fixed slots per minute and enforces one-slot consumption per indexed request until slot refill; implement SLA smoothing that computes a weighted moving average of per-tenant throughput and uses that smoothed value in the scale-decision path and the reservation safety checks; add amortized billing tags so burst usage can be reported in both instantaneous and smoothed billing views; expose two new runtime flags: --burst-slots-per-minute and --smoothing-window-seconds. Implementation notes: controller changes in pkg/allocator manage slot reservation and soft-preemption; autoscaler consults smoothing metrics instead of raw instantaneous RPS for headroom decisions; metrics exported: tenant_burst_slot_usage, tenant_burst_amortized_rps, sla_smoothing_ratio; added integration tests and a small migration path that defaults slots to 0 (no-op) unless explicitly enabled by fleet config. Rollout plan: feature-gated behind fleet config flag; staged rollout to Canary then to Dedicated fleets with monitoring dashboards and an alert on smoothing anomaly. Related: touches SUP-7643 (support report), ENG-1842 (autoscaler stability work), ENG-1910 (billing telemetry). Checklist: [x] core slot allocator and API, [x] autoscaler integration, [x] metrics & tags, [x] docs/design note, [x] integration tests, [x] e2e smoke in perf canary.

review_thread: Ben Collins: Left a few comments on concurrency and the refill goroutine; suggested using a leaky-bucket variant for refill to smooth jitter. Requested unit tests for the time-edge case when smoothing window < slot period.

Aisha Patel: Addressed Ben's comments by making refill idempotent and adding an integration test that simulates fast slot cycles; added comments explaining tradeoffs vs leaky-bucket. Pushed fix in commit 'Fix: race in slot refill worker'.

Lena Huang: Asked for a clear fallback when the flag is disabled and to ensure metrics don't produce high-cardinality labels. Confirmed that tenant id is a coarse-grain label and per-slot emission is aggregated. Approved after CI green.
Omar Sheikh: Reviewed billing tag format; requested amortized view to be available in billing export. Aisha updated billing exporter to include amortized_burst_cents; Omar gave final +1.
CI: Initial run had a flaky test in burst_slot_integration_test (timing assertion); test stabilized and all checks passed on re-run.
ci_summary: build: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: pass (flaky test fixed); lint: pass; e2e-perf-canary: pass
release_notes: Adds slotted burst quota system for Dedicated fleets; introduces SLA smoothing to stabilize autoscaler decisions; new metrics tenant_burst_slot_usage, tenant_burst_amortized_rps, sla_smoothing_ratio; feature gated and off by default; opt-in migration path for billing exports.
notes_for_ops: Enable via fleet config 'burst.slots_per_minute' and 'burst.smoothing_window_seconds'. Start with 0 slots (no-op), then enable on a small subset of tenants. Watch sla_smoothing_ratio and tenant_burst_slot_usage; alert on sustained smoothing_ratio > 0.9 which indicates under-provisioning. Billing export will include amortized_burst_cents when enabled.
